CardDescription.DefaultText: Gloves hammered from a metal sheet and sewn to leather. They protect the hands like leather gloves do and guard both arms a little, but give no warmth or comfort. Their protection, weight and look follow the metal they were made from. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

Description.DefaultText: Hammered copper plates sewn to leather, protecting the hands like leather gloves do and guarding both arms a little (+2 each). They give no warmth. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

Bronze alloyed with witchstone, pale and cold to the touch, sewn to leather: it protects the hands like leather gloves do and guards both arms a little (+2.2 each). They give no warmth. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

Hammered from soft tin: a little tougher than copper (+2.1 each) and the lightest metal gloves to carry. They protect the hands like leather gloves do but give no warmth. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

Hammered tin bronze plates sewn to leather, protecting the hands like leather gloves do and guarding both arms a little (+2.3 each). They give no warmth. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

High-tin bronze polished to a mirror shine, nearly as protective as iron (+2.5 each). It protects the hands like leather gloves do but gives no warmth. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

Forged iron gloves, the toughest of the metals (+2.7 each), protecting the hands like leather gloves do. They give no warmth and rust while you are wet unless oiled. Can be recycled in a furnace. MUST BE EQUIPPED ON EQUIPMENT SLOT TO WORK.

ActionDescription.DefaultText: Rub fat into the iron to coat it against rust. Wears off while wet. Does not repair.
Rub oil into the iron to coat it against rust. Wears off while wet. Does not repair.
Take the gloves apart to recover materials.
